body.message:
Thanks for sharing that, Neda. April 9 for one month, noted.

The units at Elite Business Bay start at AED 5,500/month, which is a bit above your budget. The closest we have to AED 4,000 is a studio in Bayz by Danube, also in Business Bay, at AED 4,400/month all-inclusive: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-bayz-by-danube-13851930.html

What time works for you tomorrow between 9am and 6pm?
